t: Advantages of Buying Direct from Manufacturer – Amcor, Inc.
s: First, with fewer individuals involved it is safe to say there will be fewer miscommunications and confusion – additionally, there will be no one in the middle to potentially misinterpret the information being relayed between customer and manufacturer.
